verse: You have a right to your work — never to its results. Do the work fully. Release the outcome.
action: Today, pick the one result you're anxious about and name it out loud. Then do one action on it.

verse: कर्म करने में तुम्हारा अधिकार है, फल में नहीं। काम पूरा करो, नतीजा छोड़ लो।
action: आज, वह एक परिणाम जिसके बारे में चिंतित हो, उसे नाम ले कर बाहर निकालो। फिर उस पर एक क्रिया करो।

verse: All that we are begins in what we have thought. Mind comes first. Mind leads. What you keep thinking, you slowly become.
action: Notice one recurring thought today. Name it. Then choose one thought to replace it with.

verse: Conduct yourself with pure deed. Speak pure speech. Think pure thought. Purify your mind.
action: Before speaking, ask: 'Is this speech pure, kind, necessary?' If not, hold it.

verse: Better indeed is self-performed action than action done by duty without understanding.
action: Before starting your day's first task, clarify: 'Why am I doing this?' Write it down.

verse: Yoga is the skill of action. — When you act, ask: is this the most skillful way, or am I just reacting?
action: Before your next task, ask: 'Is this the most skillful way I could do this?' Then do it.

verse: योग कर्म कौशलम। इकर्म करते समय सर्वोत्तम विधि पूछो या सिर्फ प्रतिक्रिया कर रहे ho?
action: अगला कार्य करने से पहले: 'मैं ऐसा क्यों कर रहा हूँ?' फिर करो।

verse: The disciplined mind remains as steady as the flame in a windless place.
action: Identify one area where your focus wanders. Gently bring it back, once, and note the difference.

verse: विनाशकाले विपरीत बुद्धि: ध्यानस्थ रहने के लिए स्थिर मन।
action: एक क्षेत्र पहचानो जहाँ ध्यान भटके। इसे वापस लाओ, एक बार नोट करो।

verse: Better indeed is self-performed action than action done by duty without understanding.
action: Before starting your day's first task, clarify: 'Why am I doing this?' Write it down.

verse: स्वाध्याययोगात्मक कर्म स्वधिक्कते। अज्ञानेन निष्फलम कर्म कर्तव्यं शारीरिणाम।
action: दिन के पहले कार्य की शुरुआत से पहले, स्पष्ट करो: 'मैं ऐसा क्यों कर रहा हूँ?' इसे लिख लो।

verse: One is bound by action, even involuntary. Therefore one should not abandon action; the truly abandoned action is that which is done without attachment.
action: Choose one routine task today and perform it with full awareness — notice every detail as you do it.

verse: एक बंधन कर्म से है, भले ही अनैच्छिक। इसलिए कर्म का त्याग न करें; वास्तविक त्याग वह है जिसे आसक्ति किए बिना किया गया है।
action: आज एक नियमित कार्य चुनें औरपूरी जागरूकता के साथ करें — हर विवरण को नोट करते हुए।

verse: All that we are begins in what we have thought. Mind comes first. Mind leads. What you keep thinking, you slowly become.
action: Notice one recurring thought today. Name it. Then choose one thought to replace it with.

verse: सब कुछ सोच से शुरू होता है। मन पहले आता है। मन नेतृत्व करता है। जो सोचते हो, धीरे-धीरे बनते हो।
action: आज एक बार-बार आने वाला विचार नोट करो। उसका नाम लगाओ। फिर एक विचार चुन कर उससे प्रतिस्थापित करो।

verse: Conduct yourself with pure deed. Speak pure speech. Think pure thought. Purify your mind.
action: Before speaking, ask: 'Is this speech pure, kind, necessary?' If not, hold it.

verse: शुद्ध देह में शुद्ध आचरण। शुद्ध वाक्य में शुद्ध वचन। शुद्ध मन में शुद्ध विचार। मन को शुद्ध करो।
action: बोलने से पहले पूछो: 'क्या यह वचन शुद्ध, मधुर, आवश्यक है?' अगर नहीं, तो रोको।
